findings.finding: Peer documents published around and after the consensus date point to a benign Q3 2026 Scandinavian claims quarter that feeds Gjensidige's underlying frequency loss ratio, which includes weather. Tryg's weather claims were DKK 83m against DKK 160m normalised and DKK 200m in Q3 2025, on 'rather benign weather patterns across the Scandinavian region'. Storebrand (21 Oct) reports a low retail claims ratio in Norway. Protector Norway's loss ratio was 58.3% against 79.3%. Gjensidige issued no storm or flood claims release in Q3 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: PBT beat of 8.8% in Q2 2026 (Placera/Finwire): +2.13%. Q1 2026 ISR up sharply: +2.35%. Q3 2025 miss: -5.13%. Q2 2024 Norway claims miss: -7.36%. An ISR beat has been rewarded by about 2%, a miss punished by 5-7%.
findings.original_quote: Storebrand Q3 2026 (no), https://newsweb.oslobors.no/message/684456, 2026-10-21: 'Veksten var primært drevet av økte markedsandeler og lav skadeprosent i personmarkedet.' (Growth was driven primarily by market-share gains and a low claims ratio in the retail market.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Gjensidige's consensus is dated 14 Oct, so it includes Tryg (9 Oct) but not Storebrand (21 Oct morning) or Protector (21 Oct after close), and its underlying FLR of 63.0% assumes about a 3pp YoY improvement, in line with Q1 (3.0pp) and Q2 (4.0pp) and not more. Against that, GJF rose 2.6% on 21 Oct while Tryg rose 0.1%, which looks like the Storebrand read-through being priced. If all of this were in the price, the run-up since 8 Oct would already equal a typical beat reaction, about 2%. It is about 9%, partly sector-wide (Tryg +11%, Protector +6% over the same span), so most of it is priced.
findings.independence: Three separate issuers' documents: Tryg Q3 report (Ritzau, 2026-10-09), Storebrand Q3 (https://newsweb.oslobors.no/message/684457, 2026-10-21), Protector Q3 (https://newsweb.oslobors.no/message/684546, 2026-10-21). None is Gjensidige's own number

findings.finding: Consensus implies a net financial result of about -36m (financial result 27m, unwinding -327m, change in financial assumptions +264m), against Q2 2026's 374m net. Peers' Q3 investment results and market data suggest it will come in at or above that: Tryg's match portfolio made DKK +124m on Danish/Norwegian credit-spread tightening, Protector's fixed income returned +0.2% and its equities +7.6%, OSEBX rose 8.8% in Q3, and Gjensidige's match portfolio earns a structural positive carry net of insurance finance (226.8m in Q2).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The market has looked through the financial line. Yahoo shows EPS below estimate in each of the last four quarters (-18%, -18%, -5%, -5%), yet the last three results days moved -0.2%, +2.35% and +2.13%, following the insurance service result.
findings.why_not_priced: The analysts' financial line ranges from -564m to +735m and the median of -68m sits below the mean, so the bar is soft and partly stale. But investors visibly discount this line (see reaction history), so a beat here moves the stock little. If the market had priced a financial beat, the stock would have outrun Tryg on 9 Oct, when Tryg showed weak investment income. It did not (GJF +2.7%, Tryg +3.2%).
findings.independence: Tryg Q3 investment section (https://via.ritzau.dk/files/90446/15217238/568086/en); Protector Q3 report (https://newsweb.oslobors.no/message/684546); Storebrand says its financial result was lower on rising rates (https://newsweb.oslobors.no/message/684457), which cuts the other way on the free portfolio

findings.finding: Gjensidige took 76 claims from the Krokstadelva (Drammen) conflagration of 18-20 July 2026, several of them total losses. It is a Q3 large-loss event, inside the 590m large-loss consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Large losses drove Q1 2025's weak result. Q2 2026 large losses were 659.6m and the quarter still beat.
findings.original_quote: '76 skademeldinger etter storbrannen' (76 claims after the major fire). e24, 2026-07-20 (https://e24.no/naeringsliv/i/7pBWa4/storbrannen-i-krokstadelva-her-er-det-helt-andre-summer): 'Gjensidige har mottatt 74 skademeldinger etter storbrannen ... Flere av boligene er totalskadet' (Gjensidige has received 74 claims after the fire; several homes are total losses). An industry commentator estimated 'opp mot 200 millioner kroner for enkeltselskapene etter at reassurandørene har dekket sin andel' (up to NOK 200m per company after reinsurance).
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and three months old, and the 590m large-loss consensus sits at a normal quarterly level (FY2025 was 2,330m, about 580m a quarter), so it is almost certainly in the bar. Filed for completeness at near-zero size. Fremtind carried the largest share (about 170 claims).

findings.finding: Average DKK/NOK and SEK/NOK rates in Q3 2026 were 7.5% below Q3 2025 (0.5% and 2.4% below Q2 2026), so Danish and Swedish revenue translates into fewer NOK. Consensus revenue of 11,802m (+5.4% YoY in NOK) appears to include this already.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 showed 7.3% NOK growth against 9.3% in local currency and the stock rose 2.1%. FX translation has not moved the stock.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the effect was visible in the Q2 release (https://newsweb.oslobors.no/message/678043) and the quarter-on-quarter change is small. Sized at 0.
findings.independence: Storebrand Q3 notes NOK appreciated about 6% against SEK during the quarter (https://newsweb.oslobors.no/message/684457)

baseline_tension: Mild agreement. The lean (-0.22, run-up only) and the +9% run-up since 8 Oct already reflect a good sector quarter, so the positive peer evidence agrees with a price that has largely moved. That is why p_up is only 56.
language_note: Gjensidige's own NewsWeb filings are bilingual (e.g. 'Gjensidige Q2 2026: Høyere forsikringsresultat' beside the English one), so the Norwegian half added nothing on the filing.

Norwegian-only: Gjensidige's mynewsdesk (no) and e24 carried the Krokstadelva fire claim counts ('76 skademeldinger etter storbrannen'; 'Flere av boligene er totalskadet') and an industry estimate of 'opp mot 200 millioner kroner for enkeltselskapene'. The English wires did not carry these; they are small and inside the bar.

Norwegian-only, and an absence: Gjensidige issued no 'uvær' or 'flom' claims release in Q3 2026, against its habit after large weather events (e.g. 'over 3 milliarder i uværsskader' after Hans). The Norwegian channel is where such a release would appear.
Storebrand's Norwegian wording 'lav skadeprosent i personmarkedet' is the same content as its English release; no extra information.
lessons_applied: Proxy / macro-to-company rule ('a narrow proxy... is a hypothesis until the company or a direct counterparty has said it'): the peer claims-quarter finding cut 0.8 -> 0.6 and the financial-result finding 0.3 -> 0.2; p_up 57 -> 56.

'Too small about the move' (abs up) and 'reiterated guide median 2.3%' (abs down) cancel for a new-numbers, no-guidance quarter: abs_move_pct left at 4.0, about the mean of this name's results-day moves (~4.1%), not capped at the 2.1% median proxy.
